verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a transcription API, and a built-in assistant in its console or playground is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Text Polishing and handing transcripts to the separate Summarizer API are fixed AI processing features, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
